A harness runs one reference skill against the engine mock and asserts postconditions; the catalog is tied to the real command surface by extending commands.contract.test.ts. notes: Off-backlog, found 2026-07-27 while auditing FS-B1's 'no second hand-maintained catalog' constraint. Two real defects fixed: the projection truncated 2 of 124 command descs (escape-unaware regex), and the shipped library.jsonl was validated against the catalog by nothing. Guard split across lanes on purpose: the cheap gate's py suite is path-scoped to service/|relay/, so the ui/-side guard is the vitest one. See docs/first-stranger-program/SKILL_CATALOG_BOUNDARY.md.

title: Autosave + crash recovery
acceptance: Interval snapshot + JSONL replay-from-snapshot (mosh-log.jsonl is the primitive); recovery prompt on unclean relaunch; save-on-quit prompt; relaunch-after-plugin-crash offers 'open without third-party plugins' (safe mode via block_plugin). kill -9 mid-edit → recovered state matches pre-kill snapshot+replay, deterministic ×3, in a harness gate. No audio-thread allocations/locks (RT-safety review).
notes: Touches MoshEngine → owner-merge bucket. First act: verify what autosave code already exists (spec §0 gap-verify). GAP-VERIFIED 2026-07-27: 4 of 6 pieces already exist — 30s interval autosave (Main.cpp 'gap 1'), unclean-exit detection (markSessionRunning/uncleanAtStartup), the recovery prompt (ui/src/ui/RecoveryNotice.tsx), and save-on-quit. MISSING: safe-mode relaunch without third-party plugins, and replay-from-snapshot. Closer to an M than an L.

title: Brain-key token proxy (Edge Function + BrainProxy retarget)
acceptance: Supabase Edge Function exposing an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint; provider key as a function secret; per-install UUID (Keychain) sent as a header; per-UUID daily budget + rate limit; hashed non-PII end-user id in provider metadata. BrainProxy retargets to the function URL; the bundled-key path is deleted. `strings` over the packaged app finds no key. (Gates need the deployed function → O4.)
notes: blockedOn O4 (deployed function + commercial key). Code is implementable now; end-to-end gate needs O4. Excluded paths (auth/secret + supabase/functions) → owner-merge. Do NOT ship a bundled key. GAP-VERIFIED 2026-07-27: the CODE half already landed (#403) — supabase/functions/brain/ exists, BrainProxy.cpp has proxy-mode support, docs/brain-proxy/RUNBOOK.md is written. What remains is deploy + secrets (O4) + flipping MOSH_BRAIN_PROXY_URL on. Do not rebuild the scaffold. DONE 2026-07-28: O4 closed. supabase functions deploy brain → ACTIVE; secrets set from ui/.env.local by variable reference (never printed); 0003_brain_usage.sql applied via the SQL editor (NOT db push — migration list showed local 0001/0002/0003 unapplied remotely while the remote held four 20260620* migrations, so db push would have tried to recreate live relay tables). Proven end to end: the dev server answers with label 'MOSH BRAIN PROXY', and it still answers with OPENAI_API_KEY/XAI_API_KEY commented OUT of the client env — which is the whole point of T1. Direct-provider path remains as fallback by design (vite tryProxy returns null on any failure).

title: R2 content-addressed take path
acceptance: On keep/commit: hash audio (reuse RenderLayer SHA-256), encode Opus proxy (96-128 kbps), upload proxy then WAV to R2 via short-lived presigned URLs (Supabase Edge Function), broadcast the reference over Realtime, peers resolve + upgrade proxy→WAV in place. Kept take audible on a 2nd peer <5s (proxy) ×3; cache hit ⇒ zero refetch; all mutations via MoshOps.
notes: blockedOn T3 (schema versioning) + S0 (sizing) + O4 (R2/Supabase). Excluded (supabase/auth) → owner-merge.

title: 4-player session

Scripted 4-user session survives join→edits→leave→rejoin→commit-storm with zero data loss, converged, ×3 deterministic.

title: First ~10 skills from the demo beats
acceptance: ~10 skills derived from the demo script's beats (O2), not a DAW taxonomy. Each passes the mock harness AND one real-engine run; failure modes produce user-legible refusals, never partial mutations (one undo txn per command holds).
notes: blockedOn O2 (demo script). Depends on FS-B1 harness. GAP-VERIFIED 2026-07-27: the SHAPE is built (ui/src/agent/skills.ts carries 9 skills after #371/#419; service/skills/ carries a mined 36-entry library.jsonl + router.py). Still genuinely O2-gated: none of those skills are DERIVED FROM the demo beats, which is the acceptance. Also see fs-b1.md — there are now TWO hand-maintained catalogs, which FS-B1 explicitly warned against. O2 WITHDRAWN 2026-07-28 (no demo). This lane's acceptance named 'the demo beats' as the skill source, so it is now blocked on an OWNER DECISION about the replacement source — not on a script. Candidates already in the tree: mine from real session logs via service/skills/mine.py (script-independent), promote from the 36-entry service/skills/library.jsonl, or hand-pick from ui/src/agent/skills.ts. Do not pick one unilaterally. SOURCE EVIDENCE 2026-07-28: option 1 (mine from real session logs) is IMPOSSIBLE, two independent reasons. (a) mosh-log.jsonl carries NO natural language — its only keys across all 2840 records are ts/seq/command/args/ok/undoable/error — and a skill needs an NL description + trigger, which cannot be derived from a command stream no matter how many sessions are run. (b) service/skills/mine.py does NOT read session logs; it mines service/sft/a3b-r4-cuda_next_run_examples.rendered.jsonl (189 SFT corpus rows). Volume also fails independently: 79% of the log is 11-13 June 2026 dev traffic, and 61 entries call add_neural_insert, deleted 2026-06-21. Option 2 (36 mined skills): only 5 have provenance >=20; 31 have 1-4 (noise); six near-duplicate create-bus-add-send* variants; one /Users/... path default. Option 3: 8 shipped skills in ui/src/agent/skills.ts. The two catalogs have ZERO overlap — they are disjoint by abstraction level (TS = workflow-level, mined = command-level), so reconcile is a layering question, not a dedupe. RECOMMENDED selection criterion: 'encodes >=2 commands that go together', not provenance count. CORRECTION 2026-07-28: this row was briefly flipped to done. It is NOT. The skill CONTENT (5 workflow skills + 19 tests) landed, but lanes/fs-b2.md's own checklist says 'Clearing O2 alone is not sufficient' — the native batch-transaction contract (transactionId, per-request idempotency, engine-owned transactionSafe registry, batch_status) is UNMERGED on branch codex/fs-b2-transaction-prereq, crash-interrupted transactions are unresolved, and no real-engine run has proved exact commit/rollback. See the addendum in the lane doc.
